title: Detailed bench test procedures (T-S1 to T-S5, T-E1 to T-E7)
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. docs/testing/test-plan.md lists tests in one line each. A lab cannot run them yet.
objective: For each bench and environmental test, write a lab-ready procedure: purpose, specimen and sample size, apparatus, conditioning, fixture sketch description, load rates, measurement, pass criteria tied to REQ IDs, and report template.
acceptanceCriteria: Every T-S and T-E test covered; each references its REQ IDs
Methods cite public standards by number and title, with no copied text
Merged as DRAFT only; release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
